verdict.rationale: Honcho documents a public API reference with autogenerated endpoint pages and interactive examples. The docs explicitly cover building integrations in languages without an SDK, backed by Python and TypeScript SDKs and scoped API keys. Agents can store messages and query context, chat, and search programmatically. missing for 10: a publicly reachable OpenAPI spec (probes of the common paths returned 404), concrete endpoint-level detail in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
